title: FCSysVal: evaluation software for the validation of a PEM fuel cell system model
description: Evaluation software of the publication "A Coverage-Aware Validation Process for Physical Energy-System Models: Demonstration on an 80 kW Fuel Cell System in an Industrial Test Environment". It computes the validation results, the measurement uncertainty and the coverage of the validation operating domain from the measurement data and the stored simulation results of the data record, without running the model.
